violations.text:
Food stored on floor.
Cases in walk in freezer

Vacuum breaker missing at hose bibb or on fitting/splitter added to hose bibb.
Next to outdoor ice machine

Hot water sanitizing dishmachine final rinse temperature at manifold exceeds 194 degrees Fahrenheit.
Reading 195+

Cloth used as a food-contact surface.
Rag used to line asparagus

Employee personal items stored in or above a food preparation area, food, clean equipment and utensils, or single-service items.
Cell phone on prep cooler

Time/temperature control for safety food cold held at greater than 41 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut melon observed at 51f. In ice bath for 40 minutes. Manager added more ice

Equipment in poor repair.
Torn gasket on reach in cooler

In-use utensil stored in sanitizer between uses.
Knives in sanitizer bucket

Single-use gloves not changed as needed after changing tasks or when damaged or soiled.
Employee coughed into gloves and touched clean equipment without changing gloves or hand washing. Education provided
Employee beverage container on a food preparation table or over/next to clean equipment/utensils.
Ice buildup in reach-in freezer and/or walk-in freezer.
In-use tongs stored on equipment door handle between uses.

Unwashed fruits/vegetables stored with ready-to-eat food.
Avocados with stickers being stored with cut avocados in same container . Chef washed and removed stickers.
